requirement.requirement_text: The system is called as a sub-workflow, triggered by a parent workflow that provides pre-analysed video data (transcript, key moments/sections, visual analysis, and metadata). For each source video it shall: (1) extract and structure the key snippets, B-roll timestamps, and video context ready for AI processing; (2) use a language model-powered AI agent to analyse the transcript, key moments, and video overview and generate 3 unique short-form concepts per video, each including a hook, body structure, CTA, full avatar script, and a lead magnet deliverable prompt, using structured output parsing to guarantee clean JSON; (3) loop through each concept and run the full production pipeline in parallel for each one: (a) send each concept's full script to an avatar video generation service to generate a vertical (1080×1920) AI avatar video, poll the status endpoint until rendering is complete, and capture the avatar video URL; (b) while the avatar renders, determine what B-roll is needed via an AI Video Director and send prompts to a video generation service to generate 2-second vertical clips at 24fps and 720p, with multiple clips generated and aggregated; (c) use a language model-powered AI Video Director to create a beat-by-beat storyboard with dynamic layout transitions, specifying layout types (avatar full-frame for hooks/CTAs, split-screen for demos, picture-in-picture overlays for focus moments), transition effects, and timing; (d) convert the storyboard into a render payload assembling avatar video, B-roll clips, transitions, text overlays, and effects into a single 1080×1920 composition, send the render to a rendering service, poll until complete, and download it; (e) upload the finished video to Google Drive and share it; (f) use a language model-powered Social Media Copywriter to generate platform-optimised titles, descriptions, hashtags, and captions for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok, and log everything to a Google Sheets tracker; (g) in parallel, use a language model-powered Document Generator to create a downloadable lead magnet (actionable guide, template, checklist, etc.) based on the CTA promise from each concept, convert it to HTML, upload it as a Google Doc, share it publicly, and link it in the tracker sheet. Visible outcomes: for each source video, 3 unique shorts are generated, and for each short — a finished rendered vertical video (1080×1920 MP4) uploaded to Google Drive; AI avatar narration with hook, body, and CTA; AI-generated B-roll video clips; dynamic layouts with scroll-stopping transitions; platform-optimised copy (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok); a lead magnet Google Doc with shareable link; and a full tracking row in Google Sheets. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.

source_spans.text: It takes the structured output from a video digestion workflow (transcript, key moments, metadata) and produces finished, rendered vertical shorts complete with AI-generated avatar narration, AI-generated B-roll video clips, dynamic multi-layout compositions, social media copy, and a lead magnet document — all uploaded to Google Drive and tracked in Google Sheets.
It's designed to be called as a sub-workflow — triggered by a parent workflow that provides video analysis data (transcript, key moments, visual analysis, metadata).
A Gemini-powered AI agent analyses the transcript, key moments, and video overview to generate 3 unique short-form concepts per video.
Each concept includes a hook, body structure, CTA, full avatar script, and a lead magnet deliverable prompt.
The agent uses structured output parsing to guarantee clean JSON.
The workflow loops through each concept and for each one runs the full production pipeline in parallel:
Each concept's full script is sent to HeyGen's API to generate a vertical (1080×1920) AI avatar video.
The workflow polls HeyGen's status endpoint until rendering is complete, then captures the avatar video URL.
The AI Video Director determines what B-roll is needed, and prompts are sent to Replicate to generate 2-second vertical clips at 24fps and 720p.
A Gemini-powered AI Video Director creates a beat-by-beat storyboard with dynamic layout transitions.
It generates a RenderScript specifying layout types (avatar full-frame for hooks/CTAs, split-screen for demos, picture-in-picture overlays for focus moments), transition effects, and timing.
assembling avatar video, B-roll clips, transitions, text overlays, and effects into a single 1080×1920 composition.
The render is sent to Creatomate's API, polled until complete, then downloaded.
The finished video is uploaded to Google Drive and shared.

Everything is logged to a Google Sheets tracker.
a Gemini-powered Document Generator creates a downloadable lead magnet (actionable guide, template, checklist, etc.) based on the CTA promise from each concept.
